notes.title: Valentines Day Crash Fix
notes.content:

notes.title: Patch notes for 28th January 2022
notes.content:
[h1]The crash reporter works![/h1]

Thank you so much to everyone who has reported a crash, it makes it soo much easier for me to track them down.

Love and Bips

notes.title: First update of 2022!
notes.content:
[h1]Happy new year bippopotamuses[/h1]

Let's kick this year off with some grown up stuff. This patch contains:

[list]
[*] No new maps
[*] No content
[*] No bug fixes
[*] Crash Reporting!
[/list]

So yeah amazing! Please submit your crashes so I can fix them. Bonus points for creative descriptions of what you were doing (in-game) when the crash happened. I'll post the best ones on twitter / discord.

M

notes.title: Bipgolf Playtest Tiny Update #2
notes.content:
What's up BipNation!

Update number two is definitely tiny, but hopefully you're gonna love it.

[h3]Better ball physics[/h3]

I ran into some issues making more crazy holes for an upcoming course (see discord for a sneak peek). So I popped the hood and dug into the gnarly bip-physics guts and played with some constants and dials.

I think the result is a much richer bip experience and I hope you like it.

[h3]New Bugs[/h3]

I would be amazed if I haven't introduced any fun new physics bugs. I've already been blown away by how helpful you've been reporting bugs with screenshots / videos etc, keep it up! The best place to report bugs is in our discord: https://discord.gg/xVh8Ph64w4

[h3]1,000 Wishlists![/h3]

We've also hit the huge milestone of 1k wishlists on Steam! This has really fired me and the rest of the Cowfish Gang up to finish off our roadmap to launch and get our first content update out to you to play with.

Love and Bips
Matt

notes.title: Bipgolf Playtest Tiny Update #1
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has tried out Bipgolf so far, especially those of you who gave us feedback and reported bugs.
Here are a few things I managed to fix this weekend:

[h3]Single player 'Practice' mode[/h3]
Changed some of the wording when playing in single player as some folks were confused that a mysterious Blue team was absolutely dominating them.
It now states you're in practice mode and doesn't berate you for losing.

[h3]Bouncy balls[/h3]
A lot of you pointed out that your balls don't bounce off the walls, which wasn't very fun at all so now your balls will bounce off the walls and each other much more.
There's also a new Lobby Setting that you can play with for some extrememly bouncy games if you fancy spicing things up...

[h3]Ball Reset bugs[/h3]
Some of you spotted a bug that caused resetting (by holding 'R') only took you back to the start of the course. I've fixed it so now it'll let you retake your last shot.
I've also fixed an issues that made you instantly max out your strokes if you held 'R' and 'F' at the same time.

[h3]Defender respawn abuse[/h3]
A few pro gamerz realised they could spam 'F' while defending which made them super OP. I've added in some balancing to help fix this.
[olist]
[*] You can no longer hold 'F' and take a shot at the same time.
[*] The default defender respawn delay is now 2 seconds, and the maximum has been increased to 20 if you need it.
[/olist]
A huge thank you to everyone in our discord community who reported these issues.
[h3]Join our community on discord: [url=https://discord.gg/xVh8Ph64w4]https://discord.gg/xVh8Ph64w4[/url][/h3]

Matt
